Sponsor Message Now Putin says Russia "is suspending its participation" in New START, the last remaining nuclear weapons treaty between the U.S. and Russia. The treaty, which took effect in 2011, is set to expire in February 2026. New START allows each country to verify the weapons pact is being followed, by inspecting the other country's nuclear arsenal multiple times each year.
